idea.name: AI pizza-ordering chatbot
idea.one_liner: A chatbot web app that gathers an order and submits it to Domino’s; no commercial model was stated.
idea.offer: A conversational interface that collects order details and places the order.

key_quotes.quote: So, what it essentially did was I, the user, had a chatbot interface.
the reason why I didn't publish this or I don't maintain it is because the API that it used to interact with Domino's was like not an official API.

ideas.delivery: The guest built a web app and chatbot for personal use. It stored answers in a database and called an unofficial Domino’s API to place the order and handle payment; he did not publish or maintain it.
ideas.other_uk_rules: If adapted to the UK, assess UK GDPR for order and account data and payment-services obligations for the payment flow.
